finalText:
All 40 tests pass now.

**Summary for Finance:** the pricing engine rounded the discounted USD amount to cents *before* converting to the order's currency, then rounded again after conversion — a double-rounding bug. It only produced visible cent errors when a percent coupon was stacked and the currency conversion pushed the value across a rounding boundary (GBP, CAD, JPY in the test matrix), which is why it looked sporadic. Fixed by deferring all rounding to a single pass at the very end, in the target currency's own decimal precision (`src/pricing/engine.js:23-28`).
